bid_stats_basis.note: The bid amounts in activityStat.applicationsBidStats have no unit attached: on fixed-price jobs they have been observed as both hourly rates and whole-project totals, and the API does not say which applies to this job. Do not compare these numbers across jobs, and do not state or imply a per-hour or per-project basis for them — report them as the bid amounts recorded for this job and say the basis is unspecified.

client_feedback.note: Reviews freelancers wrote about this client after a contract. A comment often names the client contact or the project — use those to personalize the proposal. Never infer a name that no comment states.
client_feedback.selection: at most 5 of the client's latest revealed reviews that carry a written comment, newest first

client_open_jobs.note: A sample, never a count; client_record.open_jobs also counts private jobs and this one.
client_open_jobs.selection: at most 5 of the client's other open jobs visible to freelancers; private jobs are never listed

client_work_history.note: A sample of the client's history, not all of it, and no total can be derived from it. Use client_record for their totals.

open.title: Senior Project Manager Needed for Dynamic Projects

client_work_history.selection: at most 5 open and 5 closed contracts, the latest of each by start date, newest first

content.description:
<untrusted_participant_content>
We are looking for a skilled HubSpot Developer with experience in Agentic AI, AI-powered automation, and CRM integrations to design and implement intelligent business workflows. The ideal candidate will combine HubSpot development expertise with AI agents and large language models (LLMs) to improve sales, marketing, and customer service operations.

Key Responsibilities

Customize HubSpot CRM, custom objects, workflows, properties, and pipelines.

Develop integrations using HubSpot APIs, webhooks, and custom-coded actions.

Build AI agents that automate lead qualification, customer engagement, ticket resolution, and CRM data management.

Integrate LLMs such as OpenAI or other AI models with HubSpot.

Implement agentic workflows with tool calling, multi-step reasoning, and human approval where required.

Connect HubSpot with external applications, databases, and enterprise systems.

Develop automation using Python, JavaScript/Node.js, and integration platforms.

Monitor AI agent performance, security, accuracy, and reliability.

Collaborate with sales, marketing, and customer success teams to identify automation opportunities.

Required Skills

Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot CRM development.

Knowledge of HubSpot APIs, CRM extensions, workflows, and custom-coded actions.

Experience with REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, JavaScript, or Python.

Understanding of generative AI, LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI integrations.

Experience building AI agents using frameworks or tools such as LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent.

Knowledge of JSON, databases, authentication, and cloud-based integrations.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases, and knowledge-base integrations.

Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), function calling, and multi-agent orchestration.

Experience with n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar automation platforms.

Understanding of AI governance, data privacy, and secure CRM integrations.

Success Metrics

Reduced manual CRM operations.

Improved lead response and qualification times.

Increased workflow automation and data quality.

Reliable, secure, and measurable AI agent performance.
</untrusted_participant_content>
content.title: HubSpot Developer – Agentic AI & AI Automation
